title: New ARR by product line, Q1 2024 vs Q1 2025 vs Q1 2026

spec.title: New ARR by product line (Q1, USD millions)

caption.source: FY24-FY26 bookings ledger, RevOps system of record
caption.units: USD millions of new annual recurring revenue

semantic_description.level_1_elemental: Grouped (clustered) vertical bar chart. The x-axis lists four product lines; within each cluster, three side-by-side bars compare new ARR for Q1 2024, Q1 2025, and Q1 2026, shaded light-to-dark blue. The y-axis is new ARR in USD millions on a zero baseline, $0 to ~$22M.
semantic_description.level_2_statistical: Largest single bar: Core Platform Q1 2026 at $22.0M. Fastest growth: Analytics Cloud roughly tripled ($6.2M to $19.7M, +218%) and Embedded API more than quadrupled ($2.1M to $8.9M, +324%). Core Platform grew most slowly (+20%). Across all four lines every period-over-period change is positive; total Q1 new ARR rose from $35.7M (2024) to $63.2M (2026).
semantic_description.level_3_perceptual: Each cluster's three bars rise left-to-right, so growth reads as a consistent upward staircase everywhere. Core Platform is tall but nearly flat across periods, while Analytics Cloud and Embedded API show steep widening gaps between their light and dark bars — the visual contrast makes the emerging lines' acceleration obvious against the maturing flagship.
semantic_description.level_4_contextual: The chart supports a reallocation argument: the flagship Core Platform is plateauing while two newer lines are compounding fast, suggesting incremental investment should favor Analytics Cloud and Embedded API.
semantic_description.short_alt: Grouped bar chart: new ARR across four product lines over three Q1 snapshots; all grew, Core Platform largest.
